text: dsh-intelligent-ui 是 DSH Web 插件，可在聊天中把模型编写并经目录校验的界面程序显示为原生交互卡片。插件注册 ui_render 工具和配套 skill，浏览器客户端将卡片放入工具行及回复下方。卡片可包含文本、表格、图表、函数图、公式和交互控件；用户调整控件后在浏览器本地重新计算，卡片状态可在重新载入后保留，也能让模型基于旧卡片修改。适合希望把计算、可视化或可调参数结果直接呈现在 DSH 对话中的用户。代码未要求额外 API key 或外部服务。

dsh-intelligent-ui renders validated model-authored programs as interactive cards in DSH Web chats. Its ui_render tool and skill display cards beside replies. Charts, formulas, and controls recompute in the browser, and state persists after reload. No extra API key or service is required.
想让 DSH 在聊天回复里显示能操作的交互卡片。
Can I adjust a chart or calculation in the browser without another model call?
dsh-intelligent-ui 的功能「聊天交互卡片」：通过 ui_render 工具提交界面程序；客户端在工具行流式显示，并在回复完成后将卡片放到回复下方。
dsh-intelligent-ui 的功能「本地交互计算」：卡片组件绑定状态控件，用户调整数值后浏览器重绘相关内容；会话中的卡片结果由回合数据读取并展示。

dsh-intelligent-ui README · dsh-intelligent-ui：Interactive cards in DeepSeek Harness chats. The model writes a small interface program, the chat draws it as a native card, and every control recomputes in your browser without another model call. A button sends its text as your next message.

dsh-intelligent-ui README · dsh-intelligent-ui：| | |
|---|---|
| Requires | DeepSeek Harness **>= 0.2.1-rc.1** (below 0.3.0) |
| Platforms | Web UI, macOS desktop app, and Windows desktop app — one bundle, because both desktop apps load the same web client |
| Verified | Web UI 0.2.1-alpha.4; macOS and Windows desktop apps 0.2.1-rc.2 |
| Install | Settings → Plugins → Add plugin → `https://github.com/StarsHarryZhu/dsh-intelligent-UI` (needs `git` on `PATH`), then restart the harness and reload the page |

dsh-intelligent-ui README · How it works：- The plugin registers one tool, `ui_render`, and one skill, `dsh-intelligent-ui`, which teaches the model when a card beats prose. The skill is its own part of the plugin: the Plugin Manager lists it with its own switch, and installing the plugin installs it. The model never writes HTML or JavaScript: its program is checked against the 35-component catalog and stored with the tool result. SVG it writes for a drawing is read into a checked tree with no scripts, styles, links, or images.
- A card draws in the tool row while the reply streams, and under the reply once it finishes. Moving a control recomputes every figure locally, and this browser keeps what you set, so a reload shows the card as you left it.
- Asked to change a card, the model draws a revised one that starts from your settings; the earlier card says a newer version follows.
- A `player` animates a card: code traced line by line, an algorithm's passes, a point moving along a curve. With `loop=true autoplay=true` a drawing plays by itself while it is on screen, like a GIF: a rolling wheel, a travelling wave, an orbit. Playback runs in the browser and sends nothing to the model,

dsh-intelligent-ui README · Development：```sh
node scripts/link-dev.mjs   # link the toolchain from the sibling harness checkout
node build.js               # type-check, build, and self-check the bundle
node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run
```

`AGENTS.md` holds the rules of the tree; `docs/VERIFY.md` is the live checklist.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · The 35 components：One card per component, drawn by this plugin in the host's light theme. The program behind each card is in [`docs/SAMPLES.md`](docs/SAMPLES.md).
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `card` — Layout： The framed root: optional title, padding, and gap.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `col` — Layout： A vertical stack in reading order.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `row` — Layout： Equal-width cells side by side; they wrap on a narrow screen.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `grid` — Layout： An even grid of one to four columns.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `tabs` — Layout： Pages the reader switches between, by click or arrow key; only the open page is drawn.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `tab` — Layout： One page of `tabs`, labelled by its title; pages share the card's state.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `title` — Text： A headline line in five sizes.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `text` — Text： A sentence, with `{…}` live values.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `badge` — Text： A one-word status label in five tones.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `callout` — Text： One emphasized remark: an assumption, a caveat, a next step.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `divider` — Text： A hairline separator.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `link` — Text： A citation link, opened only when clicked.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `image` — Text： An inline `data:` image with alt text and a caption.

dsh-intelligent-ui README · `code` — Text： Code or other preformatted text, kept exactly as written, with syntax colours in the host's palette, line numbers, a copy button, and `current=` highlighting the running line.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `metric` — Data： One prominent number that recomputes as controls move.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `progress` — Data： A proportion bar.

dsh-intelligent-ui README · `table` — Data： A comparison table; `current=` highlights a row, and `sortable=true` lets the reader sort by any column. Any table copies as CSV or Markdown; past 8 rows it gains a filter, and past 20 it pages.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `keys` — Data： Label and value pairs for exact figures.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `list` — Data： A bulleted list; `current=` highlights an item.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `steps` — Data： A numbered procedure; with `mono=true` and `current=`, a code listing with the running line highlighted.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `chart` — Data： A bar, line, area, or pie chart of one `values=` series, or of up to four `series` lines.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `series` — Data： One named series of a chart, stacked or side by side; the legend hides and shows it, and a readout names one column's figures.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `diagram` — Data： A flowchart laid out in layers; loops return along the side, and `current=` highlights a box.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `canvas` — Data： A drawing: `shape` lines over an optional SVG, which is read into a checked tree. Pictured with one area clicked.

dsh-intelligent-ui README · `shape` — Data： One thing on a canvas: a line, rectangle, circle, polygon, path, curve of a function, text, point, invisible area to click, or a part of the SVG placed by its id. Coordinates, turns, sizes, and fades are expressions, so a player animates them; a `point` with `drag=true` moves under the reader's pointer, and a click stores a value in a state.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `plot` — Math： Curves of y = f(x) with a marked point, its tangent, and a shaded integral.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `formula` — Math： A typeset expression with its live value.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `slider` — Controls： A range slider bound to a number.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `numberInput` — Controls： Exact number entry.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `textInput` — Controls： A one-line text field.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `select` — Controls： A dropdown choice.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `checkbox` — Controls： An on/off switch.

dsh-intelligent-ui README · `checklist` — Controls： Items to tick off with a done count; `bind=` hands the count — or the sum of the ticked items' `values=` — to the rest of the card, and `names=` the ticked names.
dsh-intelligent-ui README · `button` — Action： Sends its text as your next message, then locks the card.

dsh-intelligent-ui README · `player` — Animation： A control bar at the bottom of the card: plays, pauses, steps, and scrubs a number at 0.5× to 2×; everything that reads it follows. `loop=true` repeats a run, and `autoplay=true` starts it while the card is on screen.
